title: Pool protocol v1 message: handshake (router -> coordinator)
description: First envelope the router sends right after GET /pool/subscribe connects, before any other message. Carries the protocol version, router identity, and the initial capacity snapshot.

proto.description: Protocol version spoken by this router. Protocol v1 = 1; the coordinator may reject older versions (D-J6).

router_id.description: Stable UUIDv4 the router generated once and persists across restarts. Identifies this router; echoed back as completion.payload.served_by.

router_name.description: Owner-chosen display name for this router (shown in the portal).

software.description: Router software version string, e.g. "llama.cpp b11827-pool".

models.description: Initial capacity snapshot. Same shape as capacity.payload.models.

model_id.description: Local model id (llama.cpp model name) on this router.

tags.description: Pool classes (tags) this model serves, e.g. ["pool-text-lg"].

n_ctx.description: Context window the member runs this model with.

n_slots.description: Parallel slots configured for this model.

status.description: loaded = serving pool classes; excluded = owner excluded it from pool dispatch (D-F1).

vram_mb.description: VRAM used by this model, in MiB; null if the member cannot report it.
